meta.source: clipmoor-design-tokens.json (2026-10-28) + brief; conflicts resolved. Code-generation source: tokens.dtcg.json.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Panel ground; also menus, dialogs, image preview, collapsed bar. Customizable.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Item body (Chip, ListCard, CompactRow, ShelfCard). Equals ground in dark, where the card is drawn by `hairline`. Customizable.

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: Chip label strip AND every hover fill (old `hover` folded in). Derived.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Active block: active tab, keep-open on, primary button, selected search text. Light inverts to graphite. Derived.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop in both windows: ground at 72%. Derived.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `ground`, `card`, `strip`. 14.6:1 dark, 15.8:1 light. Customizable.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Tabs, placeholder, hints, footer captions, second line of ListCard, times. On `ground`/`card` (8.43 dark, 6.78 light) and `strip` (7.00 / 6.10). Derived.

tokens.name: text-control
tokens.usage: Pills, keycaps, secondary buttons, on `ground`/`card`. Derived.

tokens.name: text-strip
tokens.usage: Chip label-strip text on `strip`. Light value absorbs the old #2A2A2E. Derived.

tokens.name: text-strip-muted
tokens.usage: Time and icons on the label strip, on `strip` (6.25 dark, 6.10 light). Derived.

tokens.name: text-on-active
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `active` (12.34 dark). Derived.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Window edge, control outlines (search, toggle, pill, keycap, notice, buttons, inputs), menu/dialog ring, scrollbar thumb. Old `frame` + `control` merged. 3.21:1 dark, 3.51:1 light on `ground`. Derived.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Item edge and rules (filter divider, footer rule, section rules). Old `hairline` + `rule` merged. 3.21 dark; 3.24 on light `ground`, 3.53 on white `card`. Derived.

tokens.name: active-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of the active block and the active pill: always `text`.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge on colour bands, swatches and image thumbnails (decorative).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: THE ring: 2px outline, 1px offset, on the selected item only. 11.90:1 on dark ground. Never anywhere else. Customizable.

tokens.name: selection-edge
tokens.usage: Selected item's 1px border. Graphite in light because yellow on stock is 1.32:1; clear in dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The single focus ring of both windows: 2px solid, drawn INSIDE the control (offset -2px); on filled controls it takes the fill's text colour 4px in. Reads ≥12:1 on every surface it lands on (ground, strip, settings-bg, settings-surface, settings-muted).

tokens.name: type-text
tokens.usage: Text items: band and tab key only. Dark lifted to 3.26:1 on ground. Customizable.

tokens.name: type-image
tokens.usage: Image items: band and tab key only. 4.00 dark, 3.94 light. Customizable.

tokens.name: type-link
tokens.usage: Link items: band and tab key only. 4.26 dark, 3.70 light. Customizable.

tokens.name: type-code
tokens.usage: Code items: band and tab key only. Dark lifted to 3.29:1 on ground. Customizable.

tokens.name: type-locked
tokens.usage: Locked and untyped items: band and tab key only. 5.02 dark, 3.14 light. Customizable.

tokens.name: spectrum-red
tokens.usage: Colour-tab key: conic-gradient stops red, yellow, green, blue, red. Key only; a colour item's band is the copied colour itself.

tokens.name: spectrum-yellow
tokens.usage: Colour-tab key gradient stop.

tokens.name: spectrum-green
tokens.usage: Colour-tab key gradient stop.

tokens.name: spectrum-blue
tokens.usage: Colour-tab key gradient stop.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code preview: keywords, tags, decorators. 7.69 dark, 5.53 light on ground (6.03 on card).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Code preview: strings, regex, symbols. 9.26 dark, 5.51 light on ground (6.00 on card).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code preview: comments. Quieter than text-muted, still 6.15 dark, 5.07 light on ground (5.53 on card).

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Code preview: numbers and literals (true, null). Amber, kept clear of the selection yellow. 7.92 dark, 5.73 light on ground (6.25 on card).

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Code preview: function and section titles, attributes and keys. 7.86 dark, 6.10 light on ground (6.65 on card).

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Code preview: types, classes, built-ins, variables. 8.95 dark, 5.36 light on ground (5.84 on card).

tokens.name: settings-bg
tokens.usage: Settings window background and rail.

tokens.name: settings-surface
tokens.usage: Settings dialog and menu surface (both now ringed by `frame`, no shadow).

tokens.name: settings-text
tokens.usage: Settings text on `settings-bg`, `settings-surface`, `settings-muted`.

tokens.name: settings-text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, section captions, status on `settings-bg` (7.66 dark, 5.33 light) and `settings-muted` (5.86 / 4.89).

tokens.name: settings-muted
tokens.usage: Selected rail item, segmented track, hover fill, switch track when on, PaletteCard hover. Old `muted`, `accent`, `secondary` merged.

tokens.name: settings-border
tokens.usage: Row dividers only (decorative; rows are also set apart by spacing). Never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: settings-field
tokens.usage: Edge of inputs, ShortcutField, switch track when off, PaletteCard. ≥3:1: 3.45 dark, 3.36 light (was 1.26-1.59).

tokens.name: settings-segment-text
tokens.usage: Unselected segment text on `settings-muted`.

tokens.name: settings-segment-hover
tokens.usage: Unselected segment hover.

tokens.name: settings-segment-thumb
tokens.usage: Selected segment thumb.

tokens.name: settings-segment-thumb-edge
tokens.usage: Selected thumb 1px edge (decorative; the 500 weight carries the state).

tokens.name: settings-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, refusal lines, conflict errors (always with an icon and words). Low-chroma by design so it does not glare. 7.03 dark, 5.62 light on settings-bg; settings-on-danger on it 6.37 dark, 5.38 light.

tokens.name: settings-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `settings-danger` button.

tokens.name: settings-overlay
tokens.usage: Settings dialog backdrop.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label strip, preview size caption, Shelf Ctrl-number hint. Always tabular-nums. Was 11 on an inherited 16.5.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Keycap text in footers, Shelf hints, ShortcutField chips.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Pills, notice, footer captions (footer was 12/18, now 12/16), ListCard second line, SectionHeader.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: Active pill, SectionHeader, ShelfCard type name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Type tabs, menu items, DetailPane meta.

styles.name: title-strong
styles.usage: Active type tab, primary and secondary buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Item content, search text (was inherited 21px), dialog input, collapsed-bar text.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Empty-state title, dialog title in BOTH windows, panel header title (List).

styles.name: query
styles.usage: Palette layout search only (the one large field).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code item content, colour values, DetailPane code body. Never for keycaps (keycaps are sans).

styles.name: settings-hint
styles.usage: Row hints, status, errors under a field.

styles.name: settings-body
styles.usage: Row labels, rail items, inputs, segments, buttons.

styles.name: settings-title
styles.usage: Page title (h1). Line height is now a type token, not space s7.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Keycap padding-block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Segmented track inset and gap; label-to-hint gap in Settings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill padding-block; list ring room (margin -3 / padding 3 so the selection ring is never clipped). Off the 4px grid by design.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tab padding-block, gap between tabs, menu padding-block and item inline margin, empty title-to-hint.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Keycap padding-inline, pill icon-to-name, keycap-to-caption, menu item padding-block. Off-grid by design.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chip content top, tab key-to-label, gap between pills, strip icon cluster, footer row gap, preview padding, ListCard padding-block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between items, search-to-toggle, dialog actions, notice padding-block, Settings inline controls, CompactRow padding-block.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Tab and pill padding-inline. Off-grid by design.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Tabs-over-pills gap, thumbnail-to-value, footer padding-top, menu item padding-inline, field padding-inline, Settings stacked-row gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Content inset (items, strip, notice), section gap, rule-below, panel bottom inset, dialog gap, Settings row padding-block, button padding-inline.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Panel inset (sides and top), dialog padding (both windows), footer column gap, preview window margin, ghost margin. Off-grid by design.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Palette pane padding, Settings rail padding, DetailPane padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Settings label-block-to-control gap; empty-state bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Settings page padding-block and section gap; panel dialog side gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Settings page padding-inline.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Tab key (8px colour square).

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps, thumbnails, swatches, preview image, count badge.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Menu items, segments, rail items, color-editor swatches (both windows).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Search, toggle, tabs, pills, buttons, inputs, ShortcutField, notice, segmented track, empty ghost (both windows).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Items of every layout, menus (both windows; Settings menu was 8), image preview, DetailPane body, PaletteCard.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Panel window, Shelf, Palette, collapsed bar, dialogs (both windows; Settings dialog was 10).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb only.

size.note: Control heights, item modules, icons and window sizes.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small control: pills (12/16 + 3+3 + 2), Settings reset button, source chips, count badge.

tokens.name: control-segment
tokens.usage: Segment inside a 32px segmented track.

tokens.name: control-icon
tokens.usage: Ghost icon buttons beside the panel search: source filter, keep-open toggle, shortcut hints.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons in both windows (panel dialog button was 30), Settings inputs, ShortcutField, segmented track.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Search field, dialog input (both windows).

tokens.name: item-h
tokens.usage: Chip module height (body + 24px strip).

tokens.name: strip-h
tokens.usage: Chip label strip.

tokens.name: band-w
tokens.usage: Chip type band.

tokens.name: band-slim-w
tokens.usage: Type band of ListCard, CompactRow, ShelfCard, DetailPane list.

tokens.name: compact-row-h
tokens.usage: CompactRow height (compact density).

tokens.name: collapsed-bar-h
tokens.usage: CollapsedBar window height.

tokens.name: tab-key
tokens.usage: Tab key square.

tokens.name: thumb-h
tokens.usage: Image thumbnail height; colour swatch side.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside items, strips, keycaps and pills.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in 38px controls, rail, collapsed bar (the eye included).

tokens.name: menu-min-w
tokens.usage: Menu min width, both windows (madeui 160 retired).

tokens.name: menu-max-w
tokens.usage: Menu max width.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch track width (height 20, thumb 16).

tokens.name: field-shortcut-min
tokens.usage: ShortcutField min width.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: SettingsRail width.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: List/Compact panel window (fixed).

tokens.name: panel-h
tokens.usage: List/Compact panel window (fixed).

tokens.name: shelf-w
tokens.usage: Shelf window.

tokens.name: shelf-h
tokens.usage: Shelf window.

tokens.name: palette-w
tokens.usage: Palette window.

tokens.name: palette-h
tokens.usage: Palette window.

tokens.name: preview-text-max-w
tokens.usage: Preview window content width cap for text, link and code; longer lines wrap (text) or are clipped (code).

tokens.name: preview-text-max-h
tokens.usage: Preview window content height cap for text, link and code; taller content is clipped.

tokens.name: preview-swatch
tokens.usage: Colour preview swatch side.

tokens.name: settings-w
tokens.usage: Settings default size (resizable).

tokens.name: settings-h
tokens.usage: Settings default size.

tokens.name: settings-content-max
tokens.usage: Settings content column max width.

border.note: One stroke set for both windows.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Every outline, divider, frame.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Selection ring and focus ring.

tokens.name: offset-selection
tokens.usage: Selection ring outline-offset.

tokens.name: offset-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring outline-offset: inset, inside the control's border, everywhere (buttons, fields, segments, rail items, palette cards, ShortcutField). Filled buttons use -4px in their text colour.

tokens.name: offset-focus-switch
tokens.usage: The one outside ring: Switch, whose 20px pill has no room inside.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled menu items and controls.

tokens.name: opacity-idle
tokens.usage: Reset button when the row is already at its default.

tokens.name: z-popup
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, image preview.
